levels.surface: الحسن بن حازم الكلبي ابن أخت هشام بن سالم

notes: «ابن أخت هشام بن سالم» is the descriptor the text attaches to this man: kept with his name as written (rule 1)
«وَ لَيْسَ بِالْجَعْفَرِيِّ» is the editor's remark on the nisba: not a link
The saying quotes «قال رسول الله» and Ali's words «علمنيها رسول الله» inside it: no chain of their own, so no route

fixes.reason: RWY reads the editor's remark on the nisba as a transmitter; it is not a name and not a link
